**Final analysis of test image:**
- Tomato leaf with multiple discrete dark brown to black spots
- Spots are irregular in shape, scattered across the leaf, some coalescing
- No fuzzy/cottony growth (rules out Gray Mold, Late Blight)
- No obvious concentric target rings (rules out Early Blight, Target Spot)
- No powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew)
- Leaf shows some curling/distortion
- Dark, small-to-medium spots without prominent yellow halos

This pattern — numerous small dark specks/spots on a tomato leaf, scattered and coalescing — is most consistent with **Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato**, which causes small dark brown to black spots on leaves that can coalesce under heavy infection pressure.
